items.title: Everything we launched during Agents Week
items.blurb: Our latest Agents Week has come to a close. Here’s a recap of all the announcements we made, from Wallets to Radar.

items.title: From ranking to recommended: get your site ready to thrive in the age of AI agents
items.blurb: More than half of requests now come from machines, not people. Agent Readiness shows how well agents can discover and read your site, while Answer Engine Optimization tracks how often AI assistants recommend you.

items.title: Building an open Agentic Internet: readable, discoverable, callable, and payable
items.blurb: Agents are a new kind of visitor. They don't render CSS or click ads, but they have a paying human on the other end. Block them and you block your customer.

items.title: Give any website a WebMCP interface
items.blurb: Today we're launching a developer preview of WebMCP on Cloudflare. With one switch, any site becomes usable by browser AI agents — no new APIs, no origin changes — while the human stays in control and creators keep their traffic.

items.title: Using the GitHub Copilot SDK for Java
items.blurb: Enterprise Java developers have a new superpower—drive GitHub Copilot from idiomatic Java code with annotations, virtual threads, and more. The post Using the GitHub Copilot SDK for Java appeared first on The GitHub Blog .

items.title: Turn one giant AI-generated pull request to a reviewable stack
items.blurb: Instead of one huge, un-reviewable pull request, teach coding agents to decompose work into a clean, ordered stack with GitHub stacked pull requests.

items.title: Serving the most critical missions: Cloudflare for Government achieves FedRAMP Class D (High) Certified status
items.blurb: Cloudflare for Government achieves FedRAMP Class D (High) Certified status. We also announce our commitment to pursue DoD IL4 authorization. Cloudflare brings world-class security, performance, and developer products to the public sector.

items.title: Canva Shares S3 Based Architecture for Session Revocation Across Hundreds of Millions of Sessions
items.blurb: Canva redesigned session revocation infrastructure to support 100M active sessions while reducing database lookups.

items.title: Cloudflare is the only vendor named a Visionary in 2026 SASE and SSE reports
items.blurb: We're honored to announce that Cloudflare is the only vendor that has been recognized as a Visionary in both the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for SASE Platforms and the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Security Service Edge reports.
